{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify completed orders
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude any internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
# But we already checked: there are 0 such rows
# So no need to filter them out

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

total_revenue"}
